verdicts.criticalReason: PR #0 introduces a severe security regression in EmployeeDossierController.java by removing the filterDocumentsForUser call and security authorization check in downloadDossierReport, allowing unauthorized users to export restricted documents from other departments and courses in PDF downloads.

concerns.text: The controller uses System.nanoTime() for duration calculations without an injectable clock or ticker abstraction for deterministic unit testing.
EmployeeDossierSecurityTest.java was removed in this PR; security integration tests for dossier download authorization should be restored in a follow-up task.
